Dear Larkspur team,

I am writing to inquire about hiring the 1959 Pemberley Countess for a client event. The pickup is scheduled for 17/03/2027 at 08:00, and we plan to return the vehicle on 19 March 2027 at 12:00. The vehicle will be collected from your garage, and one of your chauffeurs will be required to drive it. I have attached my driving licence for your reference.

Kind regards,
Tess Ashgrove +70 221 288 5204
